search_window.basis: Since completed_at of most recent independently verified Food Line watch heartbeat; source freshness checked against publication/incident date rather than search crawl time.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Food Line recall watch; primary nationwide production collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store lost to closure/fire/disaster
Emergency food distributions canceled/suspended because of storms, flooding, fire, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or material reduction of service
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.search_engine: web fast search, recency=1 day (search results independently date screened)

failures.error: Direct webpage timed out; indexed page snapshot exposed latest announcements through Nov 6, 2026, including prior Guam WIC waiver change.
Direct page inaccessible via web tool; recurring USDA access limitation.

observations: KCRG article about JW's Foods, Kalona, Iowa, was first published Nov 8, 2026 at 10:39 PM CST (8:39 PM PST), outside window. Owners are seeking a buyer; store has not closed and discussions with buyers are active.
Guam DPHSS indexed home page lists Nov 5, 2026 termination of temporary WIC waivers, not a new in-window event. Direct page timed out.
Wisconsin FoodShare member-news page last revised Oct 16, 2026; card PIN reset and other alerts were preexisting.
Virginia DSS alerts page showed no verified newly published in-window SNAP/WIC access interruption.
Hawaii BESSD benefits processing and call-center delay information was preexisting and not attributable to a new in-window announcement.
California CDSS CalFresh page contained ongoing program and benefit resource information, not a newly announced immediate interruption.
Feeding America West Michigan mobile pantry schedule again displayed Dec 3, 2026 Ishpeming cancellation, with no dated posting or documented disaster cause; already observed in previous watch.
Search results were dominated by 2025 SNAP shutdown stories, older 2026 grocery access losses, historic weather cancellations, unrelated or non-U.S. developments.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Potential future loss, not an actual closure; first published before current hourly interval.
Previously seen Dec 3 mobile pantry cancellation without established disaster cause or new update time.
Indexed Nov 5 Guam WIC waiver notice predates this interval; no evidence of new in-window interruption.
Preexisting October FoodShare and storm replacement benefits notices.
Published October 2025, not a November 2026 SNAP interruption.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Exclude donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, program promotion, routine holiday closures, generic inflation, previously recorded incidents and out-of-window events.
coverage_notes.assessment: No newly qualifying U.S. food-access disruption verified within the bounded recall interval. Two direct page failures limit coverage; remaining independent searches and direct sources provide useful coverage. No assertion of exhaustive nationwide absence.
